data_deps.name: image_harmonization_iharmony4
data_deps.description: REAL (composite, real GT, foreground mask) triples from the iHarmony4 benchmark (Cong et al., DoveNet, CVPR 2020), resized to 64x64, for the image-harmonization tasks. Three settings = three REAL iHarmony4 sub-datasets, used as mild/medium/strong by measured foreground composite-vs-GT PSNR floor: mild=HCOCO (COCO-object composites, 2000 train/400 val), medium=Hday2night (day/night-swap composites, 200 train/80 val -- capped by the sub-dataset's small size), strong=HFlickr (Flickr composites, 2000 train/400 val). Each sub-dataset's official train/test id split is used verbatim (no leakage). Composites' foregrounds were colour-transferred by the iHarmony4 authors from real reference photos (not a synthetic knob); the un-shifted real photo is the EXACT harmonized ground truth.
